name: io.github.wppoland/merchant-ai-connector
description: Merchant AI Connector: Secure, private, read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector for WooCommerce store data in Agent Studio.

environmentVariables.name: WP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the WooCommerce store (HTTPS required)

environmentVariables.name: WC_CONSUMER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: WooCommerce REST API consumer key (Read-only permission)

environmentVariables.name: WC_CONSUMER_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: WooCommerce REST API consumer secret (Read-only permission)
